src: non-guide foreground pixels scattered on either side of the straight teal guide bar
path: orthogonal cardinal ray from each source pixel toward the guide row/column; valid only if the ray meets a guide pixel, stopping in the cell immediately before that guide pixel
trajectory: move only the source pixel to the stopping cell, merging duplicate landings
transform: keep the guide bar fixed; erase original source pixels and any source pixels whose ray meets a gap in the guide
